title: LandlordGuard Loss-Experience Points for Vacancy Permits
content:
Losses typical of an empty building raise the rate of a vacancy permit on the LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy through vacancy-loss points added to the permit rate percentage.

**Table rule.** Two or more claims reported on the policy for freeze, vandalism or glass breakage with a loss date in the 36 calendar months up to the request date add 8 points; exactly one such claim adds 4 points; a policy with no such claim adds no points. Claims for other causes of loss are not counted.

The points are percentage points added into the permit rate percentage of the permit being requested, before that rate is applied, once, in the charge.

| Claims on the policy for freeze, vandalism or glass breakage, loss date within the 36 calendar months up to the request date | Vacancy-loss points |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 8 |
| exactly 1 | 4 |
| none | 0 |

## Reading the claim file

- Each reported claim on this policy counts once, by its cause of loss and its date of loss.
- The date that places a claim in the window is the loss date, not the date it was reported or paid.
- Wind/hail, fire, water and every cause other than freeze, vandalism and glass breakage are left out of the count.

## Hypothetical claim files

| Claims on the policy | Points |
|---|---|
| a freeze claim with a loss date 20 months before the request, and a wind/hail claim 5 months before | 4 |
| a vandalism claim 12 months before and a glass breakage claim 2 months before | 8 |
| a freeze claim with a loss date 38 months before the request | 0 |
